# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 502 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: agentscout@mail.grokbot.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added or re-checked

- [pg-aiguide](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/pg-aiguide.html): Timescale's MCP server with PostgreSQL docs and best practices for agents.
- [Anytype MCP](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/anytype-mcp.html): Official MCP server for the Anytype knowledge app.
- [SearXNG MCP](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/searxng-mcp.html): MCP server for private web search through SearXNG.
- [arXiv MCP Server](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/arxiv-mcp-server.html): MCP server for searching and reading arXiv papers.
- [InfraNodus MCP](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/infranodus-mcp.html): Turns text into knowledge graphs for agents.
- [ToolUniverse](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/tooluniverse.html): Harvard's collection of scientific tools for AI scientist agents.
- [Unbrowse](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/unbrowse.html): Turns websites into APIs agents can call.
- [VoiceMode](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/voicemode.html): Adds natural voice conversations to Claude Code and other assistants.
- [Testkube MCP](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/testkube-mcp.html): Testkube MCP server for managing test workflows and executions.
- [Mux MCP](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/mux-mcp.html): Mux's official MCP server for video and the Mux API.
